text:
Alex C.: alert from monitoring — ap-south GPU pool at 94% and pod restarts increasing. 503s climbing for low-priority routes
Maria G.: seeing increased queue depth on ap-south egress, also some NAT gateway errors reported :warning:
Jin H.: confirmed, kernel logs show TCP retransmits on the ap-south edge nodes. could be transient but capacity is tight
Alex C.: can we shift traffic off ap-south to avoid crashes? prefer staged weight shift, not full failover
Ryan O.: +1. prefer weight change via rw-router so routing keeps most state. we can route lower-priority customers first
Ben S.: runbook suggests: 1) reduce ap-south weights by 30% 2) route to us-west / ap-northeast 3) watch KV cache hit rates 4) rollback if latency > 200ms
Alex C.: ok I'm going to enact a staged weight update. lb-bot, prepare change set
lb-bot: preparing routing update for rw-glb: generate change-id 0x7c2f. current weights = {ap-south:60,ap-northeast:20,us-west:20}
Alex C.: executing step 1 -> decrease ap-south to 40, increase ap-northeast to 35, us-west to 25. command:
```
rw-router set-weights --change-id 0x7c2f --weights ap-south=40,ap-northeast=35,us-west=25
```
Maria G.: applying now
oncall-bot: change 0x7c2f started by Maria G. • ETA 90s • monitors: latency, error-rate, gpu-util
Maria G.: change applied. watching dashboards
Jin H.: KV cache hit dropped ~8% (expected), tail latency for chat-gen up ~30ms but within SLO
Ben S.: ap-south GPU util dropped to 78% after shift, restarts stopped. nice
Alex C.: nice. any sign of connectivity flaps?
Jin H.: NAT errors decreased, TCP retransmits back to baseline. no new OOMs reported
Ryan O.: cost note — shifting load to on-demand us-west GPUs will raise burn. estimated delta ~$4k/day if sustained
Alex C.: acknowledged. prefer to keep current weights until tomorrow morning traffic drop, then we can drain and patch ap-south nodes
Maria G.: opened an infra ticket to drain and upgrade kernel on ap-south edge nodes: INFRA-4891
Ben S.: scheduling a maintenance window for 03:00 UTC to avoid peak; will do rolling drain and reattach to pool
Alex C.: thanks. I'll mark this thread for follow-up and set a post-incident check tomorrow. :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: incident note appended to INFRA-4891: "staged routing shift mitigated capacity saturation in ap-south; follow-up maintenance required"
Ryan O.: closing loop: traffic currently ap-south 40 / ap-northeast 35 / us-west 25; error-rate back to baseline; monitoring set to high-frequency for 4h
Maria G.: updated runbook with the exact rw-router commands and rollback steps
Alex C.: resolved for now. great coordination, team.
Maria G.: :thumbsup:
